summary: @servicetitan/assist-utils preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime binary (pinned to v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled ~727KB sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated using an obfuscator.io-style rotated string array (WV8StW shift over a large numeric/string constant table) and bears no relation to the package's advertised purpose as a small React hooks library (dist/index.js only re-exports AtlasProvider / useAtlasContextRegister / ATLAS_SYSTEM_MESSAGE). setup.mjs itself is also obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers) to hide the download-and-exec chain. Executing the payload under a freshly downloaded Bun binary rather than the ambient Node runtime is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that evades Node-focused install-time scanners. The dropper is orthogonal to the legitimate shipped library and is not referenced in the README or CHANGELOG, consistent with an @servicetitan scope hijack or compromised publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
